start: A gym member, internet on, on the Gym tab

user_sees: Page 'Message your gym'; 'What is it about?' with 'Question', 'Feedback', 'Complaint'; who reads it under the choice; a box with 'For example: Is the gym open on Diwali?'; '0 of 1000 letters'; 'Send message' greyed
must_not: A 'Send message' button that works with an empty box

steps.action: Pick 'Question', type a question, tap 'Send message'
user_sees: 'Sent. When your gym replies, you will see it below.'; the message on top of 'Your messages' with 'Not seen by your gym yet. Waiting for a reply.'
must_not: Two messages after one tap; the typed text kept after a send that worked

steps.action: When the gym replies, tap the notification
user_sees: This page opens with the reply under the message, from '<name> from your gym'
must_not: The notification opening another member's thread

start: A gym member on a running paid plan whose gym has trainers, opened from Settings, What my gym can see, or a trainer's reply notification (/shop/ask)

user_sees: The same page opened on 'A trainer': trainer chips with the member's own trainer marked and 'Any trainer'; box up to 500 letters
must_not: 'A trainer' offered to a member whose plan ended

user_sees: The question with the trainer's name and when it was asked; 'Take back' button
must_not: The question going to a trainer the member did not pick

user_sees: The question goes from the list
must_not: The trainer still seeing a taken-back question

start: A gym member with news from the gym, on the Gym tab

user_sees: Page 'Messages', 'From <gym>', newest first, each card with its kind, title, body and when sent
must_not: Messages from a gym the member left

steps.action: Come back to the Gym tab
user_sees: The bell's number is gone; the gym's panel counts the member under 'seen by'
must_not: Messages marked seen that were never on screen

start: A gym member whose trainer sent a diet plan

steps.action: On the Gym tab tap 'Diet plan'
user_sees: Page 'Diet plan': plan title, 'From <gym> . <trainer> . <date>', goal, targets, meals with times, 'Notes from your trainer', the doctor line
must_not: A plan dated a day early; a plan meant for another member

steps.action: Pull down to refresh after the trainer changed it
user_sees: The new meals
must_not: The old plan kept with no word

start: A gym member on Message your gym

user_sees: Not possible: only feedback can be sent without the name
must_not: A question or complaint sent without the name

user_sees: The box stops at 1000; '1000 of 1000 letters'
must_not: A message cut short with no word

user_sees: An error line; the typed words stay
must_not: 'Sent' shown for a message that did not go

start: A member with no gym, or a gym whose server has no messages yet

steps.action: Open /shop/message, /shop/ask, the inbox or the diet plan address with no gym
user_sees: The Gym tab's join screen
must_not: A message page that sends to nowhere

steps.action: Open Message your gym at a gym without messaging
user_sees: 'Messaging your gym is not ready yet. Please check again later.'
must_not: An endless 'Loading...'

steps.action: Open Diet plan with no plan sent
user_sees: 'No diet plan yet' with 'When your trainer at <gym> sends you a diet plan, it shows here by itself...'
must_not: A blank page

start: A gym member whose message was seen, then done

steps.action: Open Message your gym after the gym saw the message
user_sees: 'Seen by your gym. Waiting for a reply.'
must_not: 'Not seen' still shown

user_sees: 'Your gym marked this as done. Write back if you need more help.' and 'Write back'
must_not: No way to write back

user_sees: 'Sent.'; the thread is open again for the gym
must_not: A new thread made instead of a reply

start: A gym member choosing who reads a message

user_sees: 'Only the owner and front desk at <gym> read your feedback. Your trainers do not see it.'
must_not: A trainer able to read the feedback

user_sees: 'Only the owner of <gym> reads your complaint. The front desk and trainers do not see it.'
must_not: The desk or a trainer seeing the complaint

user_sees: Messages deleted at once by the gym
must_not: Old messages still in the gym's panel after leaving
